name: Northeastern AI combined degrees
description: Reviewed Northeastern combined undergraduate degrees integrating AI with partner disciplines. Shared computing/AI requirements and applicable university policies are stored once; each degree preserves its award, catalog hosting context, domain curriculum, integration and evidence. Catalog hosting does not predetermine a student’s designated home college. The grouping and shared scope are analyst-classified.

shared_requirements.title: NUpath applicability
shared_requirements.summary: Applies to first-year entrants from fall 2016; previously admitted students with another core and transfer students with earlier entry years follow their applicable rules.

shared_requirements.title: Competency-based course eligibility
shared_requirements.summary: Use approved NUpath attributes in course/section listings. Major, minor, concentration or elective coursework can qualify without additional course-level or semester-hour restrictions. Pass/fail and satisfactory/unsatisfactory coursework cannot qualify. This is an eligibility criterion, not an invented extra course pool.

shared_requirements.title: NUpath overlap limits
shared_requirements.summary: One course may fulfill at most 2 of the first eight competencies; writing-intensive-in-major, capstone and experiential attributes can additionally overlap without that cap.

shared_requirements.title: NUpath transfer and examination limits
shared_requirements.summary: Transfer/placement credit may fulfill at most 5 of the first eight competencies using Northeastern course equivalents. Transfer cannot fulfill capstone or experiential requirements; among writing requirements, only first-year writing permits transfer/placement credit.

shared_requirements.title: First-year writing standard
shared_requirements.summary: Complete an approved first-year writing option with C or higher, or qualifying advanced placement/transfer credit. The writing program uses guided self-placement and requires an essay at the first class meeting.

shared_requirements.title: Advanced writing standard
shared_requirements.summary: Complete advanced writing with C or higher. Enrollment requires first-year writing, at least 64 academic semester hours including the enrollment semester, and junior/senior standing. Transfer credit cannot satisfy advanced writing; choose the appropriate program-approved section with advising.

shared_requirements.title: Writing-intensive work in the major
shared_requirements.summary: Complete at least 2 additional writing-intensive major courses, beyond first-year and advanced writing. Approved major courses may also fulfill other NUpath attributes within the overlap rules.

shared_requirements.title: Qualifying experiential engagement

shared_requirements.summary: Complete a qualifying internship.

shared_requirements.title: Clinical placement
shared_requirements.summary: Complete a qualifying clinical placement.

shared_requirements.title: Approved industry-partnership course
shared_requirements.summary: Complete an approved course requiring an industry-partnership project.

shared_requirements.title: Experiential requirement scope
shared_requirements.summary: The standard U.S.-campus matriculated degree rule applies to these Boston degree programs. Published exceptions cover nondegree, CPS undergraduate, online/primarily online, PhD and certificate programs, continuing Mills/Marymount Manhattan students, and London dual-degree students; assess any individual exception against that policy.

shared_requirements.title: Graduation Requirements
shared_requirements.summary: Published university policy criteria; apply alongside the concrete program requirements.

shared_requirements.title: Graduation and diploma clearance
shared_requirements.summary: Meet academic, program, experiential and residency requirements and remain in good standing. Clear financial, experiential-education and disciplinary deficiencies before diploma receipt; the college advising office reviews the degree audit.

shared_requirements.title: Coursework after matriculation
shared_requirements.summary: Complete degree coursework at Northeastern, an entity with a formal contractual/consortial/partnership relationship, or approved Northeastern study abroad. Taking another accredited institution’s course requires a college petition under the published exceptions.

shared_requirements.title: Graduation application
shared_requirements.summary: Submit the graduation application by the published deadlines to receive the diploma, including when not attending the optional ceremony.

shared_requirements.title: Degrees, Majors, and Minors
shared_requirements.summary: Published university policy criteria; apply alongside the concrete program requirements.

shared_requirements.title: Combined-major discipline and integration criteria
shared_requirements.summary: The combined major includes at least 9 courses from each participating discipline, at most 2 courses counting in both, and at least 16 courses overall, with multiple curricular integration points. These are program-design/fulfillment criteria, not additional courses to add to the published degree plan.

shared_requirements.title: Designated home college
shared_requirements.summary: A designated home college registers and graduates the student; most combined majors allow a home-college choice. Catalog hosting context does not establish an individual student’s choice. Apply that college’s published rules and approved program of study.

shared_requirements.title: Combined-major award identity
shared_requirements.summary: Completion earns one major, one degree and one diploma; the combined major and home college appear on transcript and diploma. Preserve the concrete program’s BS or BSEnvE designation.

shared_requirements.title: Academic Progression Standards
shared_requirements.summary: Published university policy criteria; apply alongside the concrete program requirements.

shared_requirements.title: University academic standing
shared_requirements.summary: Maintain overall GPA 1.800 at each first-year semester end and cumulative GPA 2.000 thereafter; earn at least 12 semester hours in the completed semester. Individual colleges/programs may add progression criteria.

shared_requirements.title: Incomplete grades and probation
shared_requirements.summary: When pending incomplete credits leave a student below full-time status, GPA determines temporary probation until the incomplete is resolved. Full-time students missing good-standing criteria are placed on academic probation for the following semester.

shared_requirements.title: Dismissal and appeal policy
shared_requirements.summary: Two full-term semesters of continuing probation may lead to dismissal. A GPA below 1.000 or fewer than four earned hours in a semester or cumulatively may also trigger college-discretionary dismissal; pending incompletes are excluded. Students may appeal to their college Academic Standing Committee.
